scope: Compare the deployed GTK2 scrollbar arrow assets with the current theme source and determine whether the open XChat processes predate the deployed files.

observations.geometry: Arrow PNGs are 11x11; stepper cells are 15x15. R453 independently confirms the current isolated GTK2 renderer's normal horizontal 15x15 cells match the retained VUE reference 0/225 pixels.

gtk2_reload_semantics.observation: GTK 2.24 source for gtk_rc_reparse_all_for_settings checks modification times of parsed RC files and then clears/rebuilds style data. This is an explicit reparse path; it does not establish that an already-open app automatically notices a replacement PNG or that its theme engine refreshes the image cache.
gtk2_reload_semantics.implication: The open XChat processes predating the installed asset update strengthens the stale-process hypothesis, but a fresh-process visual check is still required to distinguish it from a renderer or widget difference.

result: The open XChat processes started before the deployed GTK2 arrow assets were replaced, while the installed files currently match the repository. A stale in-process GTK2 pixbuf/style cache is therefore a plausible explanation for the reported appearance, but this read-only audit does not prove which files either process loaded or how it currently renders them.
limits: No XChat title, message content, screenshot, focus, input, restart, or theme file was accessed or changed.
No VM input was sent. verify.sh continues to guard against concurrent use of the project and Prancheta MAME instances.
This does not replace the pending native SR10.4 state comparison or live XChat scrollbar-only comparison.
next: After the separate MAME releases the guard, complete the specific pending VUE comparisons and then validate the live GTK2 scrollbar without reading chat content; do not modify normal arrow geometry absent a reproduced visual difference.
